description: This file defines the `TableStorageUpdateConditionNotSatisfiedException` class, a custom exception used within the Orleans.Storage namespace to indicate a specific error condition related to Azure Table Storage operations, particularly when an ETag mismatch occurs during a state write.

classes.name: TableStorageUpdateConditionNotSatisfiedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating a failed conditional update in Azure Table Storage, derived from InconsistentStateException. It holds information such as grain type, grain id, table name, and ETags to describe the specific conflict.

methods.name: TableStorageUpdateConditionNotSatisfiedException (constructor with parameters)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the exception with a custom message and relevant details about the failed update condition.

methods.name: CreateDefaultMessage
methods.description: Generates a default error message string incorporating grain type, grain id, table name, stored ETag, and current ETag.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Serializes the exception data for persistence, including grain type, grain id, and table name.
